title: A second pass for food
hook: Not every pellet follows the same route.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors suited to particular conditions.
doesNotKnow: The arrows show a soft cecotroph returning to the mouth for another digestive pass. Rabbits normally re-ingest these nutrient-rich pellets; the drawing does not show every digestive organ or the timing of the cycle.

misconception: A familiar animal behavior or structure must work in a different way.
objective: What happens to nutrient-rich cecotrophs in the rabbit’s digestive cycle?
